title: Booking Lead and the Cancellation Notice Required for In-Person Appointments
content:
For a patient cancellation of an In-Person Appointments visit, the notice days required depend on how far ahead the visit was booked, measured as the days from the booking date to the scheduled date of the visit:

| Days from booking date to scheduled date | Rise in notice days required |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 2 days |
| 30 to 59 | 1 day |
| fewer than 30 | none |

The booking date is the date the booking was made, as shown on the appointment record; a later move of the visit does not change the booking date.

**Band edges (hypothetical dates).**

- Booked 2026-09-01 for 2026-10-31: 60 days, so a rise of 2 days. Booked 2026-09-02 for the same date: 59 days, so a rise of 1 day.
- Booked 2026-10-01 for 2026-10-31: 30 days, so a rise of 1 day. Booked 2026-10-02: 29 days, so no rise.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** An Annual Preventive Exam, whose booking horizon runs to 365 days, booked 120 days ahead, falls in the 60-or-more band; a Nurse Visit booked 10 days ahead falls in the fewer-than-30 band.
